title: 大古力水壩~Grand Coulee Dam
focus: 水電灌溉抽水與大型機組更新介面~Hydropower irrigation pumping and major unit renewal interfaces
summary: 大古力案例將發電與灌溉抽水放入同一能量和水量帳，並追蹤前池水位、管路阻力與機組停機如何相互影響。課程接續混凝土分塊、基礎排水與量測基準，再以灌溉回歸流及更新後效率驗證收束；學員須解釋不同時間尺度的資料為何不能直接相減。~The Grand Coulee case places generation and irrigation pumping in one water and energy account and follows interactions among forebay level, pipe resistance and outages. Concrete blocks, foundation drainage and survey reference control lead into irrigation return flows and post-renewal efficiency verification. Learners explain why observations from different time scales cannot simply be subtracted.
history: 墾務局施工史記載大古力工程於一九三三年開始，第一批混凝土在一九三五年澆置，灌溉抽水設施於一九五一年完成。這些分期事件提醒學員：攔河壩、發電與灌溉系統不是同一天形成的單一設備。本課以此分期背景研究接口責任與守恆，並不聲稱假想流量等於現場抽水量。監測手冊出版年代另列為知識背景，二〇二六年的來源核對也與歷史建設明確區分。~Reclamation construction history places the start of Grand Coulee in 1933, the first concrete in 1935 and completion of the irrigation pumping plant in 1951. These stages show that the dam, generation and irrigation systems did not arrive as one device on one date. The course uses that sequence to examine interfaces and conservation, without identifying assumed flows as field pumping records. Instrumentation publication dates describe reference history, and the 2026 source check is distinguished from construction.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「灌溉抽水能量帳」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「發電抽水淨交換」及「前池水位緩衝」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW；第二組為 Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Irrigation pumping energy account, then compare the controlling variables in Generation pumping net exchange and Forebay level buffering. The first calculation is rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW; the second is Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 灌溉抽水能量帳~Irrigation pumping energy account
units.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳~Irrigation pumping energy account
units.mechanism: 發電廠與抽水站共用水資源時，抽水所需能量不能從發電流量直接相減。抽水揚程包含上下游能量高程差與管路損失，電端輸入還需除以泵及馬達效率。先把取水量、提高的位能與耗電分列，才能比較不同灌溉時程的水能代價。 若以每立方米耗電比較方案，應將功率除流量並正確換算能量單位，才能消除單純抽水規模不同的影響。~When generation and irrigation pumping share a water resource, pumping energy cannot be subtracted directly from generating discharge. Pump head includes the difference in energy elevations and conveyance losses, while electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump and motor efficiency. Separate water volume, gained potential energy and electricity before comparing irrigation schedules. Comparing energy per cubic metre requires dividing power by flow with consistent energy units, separating scale of pumping from the underlying hydraulic and efficiency effects.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW。模型邊界：揚程含全部假定水力損失，效率為電端至水力總效率；穩態計算。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW. Model boundary: head includes assumed hydraulic losses and efficiency is overall electrical-to-hydraulic efficiency; steady operation.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。將實測耗電按每立方米水量表示，若隨水位降低而升高，須區分靜揚程增加與設備效率下降。~Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference. Express consumption per cubic metre. If it rises as the source level falls, distinguish increased static lift from deterioration of equipment efficiency.
units.failure: 進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。~An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. Different meter integration windows can also create a false efficiency change and must be checked before diagnosing the pump.
units.misconception: 抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率~Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
units.practice: 固定輸送體積，分別比較高水位短時抽水與低水位長時抽水的總耗電，列出效率及管路阻力資料，避免只用尖峰功率選方案。~For a fixed delivered volume, compare short pumping at a high source level with longer pumping at a low level. List efficiency and resistance data needed before choosing a schedule from peak power alone.

units.anchor: 發電抽水淨交換~Generation pumping net exchange
units.title: 發電抽水淨交換~Generation pumping net exchange
units.mechanism: 電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。不同設備的電表可能位於變壓器前後，必須統一計量邊界再作加減。水量帳也需另列，因取水到灌區的時間延遲不等於電力交換時段。 輔機可能由外部電網供電而非機組母線供電，淨外送與自用電帳必須依實際接線拓撲定義。~Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. Meters may sit on different sides of transformers, requiring a common boundary. Maintain a separate water account because delivery time to irrigation areas differs from the electrical exchange interval. Auxiliaries may draw from an external grid rather than the generating bus, so net export and internal consumption depend on the actual electrical connection topology.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。模型邊界：所有功率同一時間與電端邊界，不另重扣已含於電表的損失。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Model boundary: all powers use the same interval and electrical boundary; losses already included in readings are not deducted again.
units.verify: 畫出每只電表相對母線及變壓器的位置，逐項核對輔機是否已含於淨電表，再比較各分表積分與外送總表。若殘差隨抽水啟停改變，應追查漏列負載或不同量測邊界，不先假設發電機效率跳變。~Map each meter relative to buses and transformers, check whether auxiliaries are already included, and compare integrated submeters with export metering. A residual that changes with pump switching suggests a missing load or inconsistent boundary before it suggests a sudden generator-efficiency change.
units.failure: 把抽水耗電同時列為輔機與獨立項目會重複扣除，造成虛假的低外送；若時間平均方式不同，短時啟動尖峰也可能被錯配到另一設備的時段。~Counting pump demand both as an auxiliary and a separate item double-deducts energy and understates export. Different averaging windows can also assign a brief starting peak to the wrong equipment interval, producing an apparent unexplained loss.
units.misconception: 淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降~Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.
units.practice: 為三種抽水時程計算日淨外送電量，並讓總抽水量相同，說明電價時序、灌溉需求與設備效率各需何種附加資料才能比較。~Calculate daily net export for three pumping schedules with equal delivered water. Explain the additional price timing, irrigation-demand and equipment-efficiency information needed to compare their practical consequences.

units.anchor: 前池水位緩衝~Forebay level buffering
units.title: 前池水位緩衝~Forebay level buffering
units.mechanism: 前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。矩形水池的面積模型適合建立短時反應尺度；若池形變化大、波浪明顯或連接渠道長，則需把儲存與傳播分開，不能把所有測點當成同時同高。 渠道水面振盪能使局部水位先升後降而總儲量近乎不變，多站平均與流量積分提供不同但互補的資訊。~A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions. A constant-area model establishes a short-term response scale. Strongly varying geometry, waves or long connecting canals require separate treatment of storage and propagation instead of assuming every gauge changes simultaneously. Surface oscillation can raise and lower a local level with little total storage change; multi-gauge averages and flow integration provide distinct complementary information.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m。模型邊界：面積固定且忽略波浪與側向取水；負號表示水位下降。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m. Model boundary: constant surface area, no waves or lateral withdrawals; negative sign denotes falling level.
units.verify: 以同時段入出流積分預測水位，再比較多站平均水位與單點波動。若單點振盪而平均儲量變化符合帳本，應研究水面振盪；若所有站都偏離，先檢查流量偏差與實際面積。~Integrate inflow and outflow to predict level, then compare the average of several gauges with local fluctuations. Oscillation at one station with a closing storage balance suggests surface motion. Coherent disagreement across stations instead calls for checking discharge bias and actual surface area.
units.failure: 前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。~Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence. A sensor in a high-velocity zone can also mistake local dynamic effects for a loss of storage throughout the forebay.
units.misconception: 單點瞬時水位完全代表前池儲量~One instantaneous local level fully represents total forebay storage.
units.practice: 將緩衝面積減半並改成兩段出流，逐段計算水位，畫出泵啟動前後的測站佈置，指出何時常面積模型不再足夠。~Halve the buffering area and use two successive outflows. Compute the level segment by segment, locate gauges around pump starting, and identify observations that would invalidate the constant-area model.

units.anchor: 輸水管摩阻尺度~Conveyance friction scaling
units.title: 輸水管摩阻尺度~Conveyance friction scaling
units.mechanism: 灌溉輸水損失隨流速增大而快速上升，達西摩阻式把管長、直徑與粗糙影響放在同一能量帳。摩阻因子並非固定材料常數，會受雷諾數及相對粗糙度控制。教材固定因子只為隔離流速效應，實際比較前必須核對流況與局部構件。 截面直徑改變也會改變速度水頭，壓力差不全是耗散，必須先扣除可逆的動能與高程變化。~Conveyance loss rises rapidly with velocity, and Darcy-Weisbach places length, diameter and roughness effects in one energy account. The friction factor is not a fixed material property; Reynolds number and relative roughness matter. Holding it constant isolates velocity effects for teaching, while field comparisons require flow-regime and fitting checks. A diameter change also changes velocity head, so pressure difference is not entirely dissipation; first account for reversible kinetic and elevation-energy changes between sections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=0.018 (dimensionless); L=900 m; D=4 m; v=3 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f*(L/D)*v*v/(2*g)=1.857798165 m。模型邊界：使用達西摩阻因子，穩態滿管且不含局部損失。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=0.018 (dimensionless); L=900 m; D=4 m; v=3 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f*(L/D)*v*v/(2*g)=1.857798165 m. Model boundary: Darcy friction factor, steady full-pipe flow, excluding local fitting losses.
units.verify: 量測兩斷面壓力並補正高程及速度水頭，再把剩餘能量差與摩阻式比較。改變流量時查看損失與流速平方是否一致；若僅某閥位下突增，應分列局部損失而非把全部效應塞進管壁粗糙度。~Measure pressure at two sections and correct elevation and velocity heads before comparing energy loss. Vary discharge to examine velocity-squared behavior. A jump associated with one valve position should be treated as local loss rather than absorbed entirely into inferred wall roughness.
units.failure: 混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。~Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness. Trapped air or partially full flow also violates the equation assumptions and should be investigated through pressure fluctuations and air-release records.
units.misconception: 不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換~Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly.
units.practice: 把流量提高兩成，在直徑不變下重算流速與摩阻，再增加一個已知局部損失係數，分別列出兩種損失對總揚程的貢獻。~Increase flow by twenty percent at unchanged diameter and recalculate velocity and friction. Add one known local-loss coefficient and separately account for each contribution to the total pumping head.

units.anchor: 灌溉回歸流水帳~Irrigation return flow accounting
units.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳~Irrigation return flow accounting
units.mechanism: 從水庫取出的水不全等於流域消耗，部分可能在不同時間和位置回到河道。課程把取水、作物蒸散、渠道蒸發、地下儲存與回歸流分開，先建立明確邊界的日帳。回歸水水質與到達時間也可能限制再利用，不能只靠體積差評價灌溉效益。 回歸水若跨越原先劃定邊界，需改列外部輸出而非區內儲存，控制體選擇會改變各項名稱但不改守恆。~Water withdrawn from a reservoir is not identical to basin consumption because some returns at another time and location. Separate withdrawal, crop evapotranspiration, canal evaporation, subsurface storage and return flow within a declared daily boundary. Return-water quality and arrival time can constrain reuse even when the volume account closes. Return water crossing the chosen boundary is an external output rather than internal storage; control-volume choice changes labels while preserving the conservation requirement.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day。模型邊界：所有項目同一灌區邊界與日尺度，正儲存表示留在區內。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day. Model boundary: all terms share one irrigation-area boundary and daily interval; positive storage remains within the area.
units.verify: 將渠道進出流、土壤含水與作物蒸散估計對齊到同一天，另核對回歸水在下游的延遲。若日帳不閉合而多日累計閉合，可能是地下儲存及到達時間問題，不宜直接指認未計量取水。~Align canal flows, soil-water observations and evapotranspiration estimates to the same day, checking downstream return-flow delay separately. Daily imbalance that closes over several days may reflect subsurface storage and travel time rather than an unmetered withdrawal from the irrigation system.
units.failure: 將深層滲漏一律稱為浪費，可能忽略可回收地下水；但把所有滲漏都視為可利用回歸流也會高估供水，因水質、流向與時間均可能不符合需求。~Calling all deep percolation waste can ignore recoverable groundwater. Treating it all as usable return flow can equally overstate supply because water quality, direction and arrival time may fail to match the downstream demand.
units.misconception: 水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量~Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use.
units.practice: 加入一日延遲的回歸流，建立連續三日水量表，再比較單日與三日淨消耗，提出一項能檢查地下儲存變化的現地觀測。~Add a one-day delay to return flow and construct a three-day balance. Compare daily and cumulative consumption, then propose a field observation that can test the inferred change in subsurface storage.

units.anchor: 混凝土分塊溫差~Concrete block temperature mismatch
units.title: 混凝土分塊溫差~Concrete block temperature mismatch
units.mechanism: 相鄰壩塊不同的溫度歷程會造成相容變形差，而不是每塊都在相同溫度下同步收縮。教材比較兩塊的自由熱應變差，作為接縫運動的來源之一；澆置齡期、徐變與約束會改變實際應力，因此應變差不能直接乘一個彈性模數就宣告開裂。 兩塊混凝土即使最終溫度相同，也可能因不同齡期的約束與徐變而留下不同殘餘應力，不能只比較終值。~Neighboring blocks can have different thermal histories and therefore different free strains rather than cooling together. Their free thermal-strain difference is one source of joint movement. Placement age, creep and restraint alter actual stress, so multiplying this difference by one elastic modulus does not by itself establish cracking. Two blocks reaching the same final temperature may retain different stresses because restraint and creep developed at different ages; matching endpoints does not establish equivalent histories.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; dTA=10 K; dTB=4 K; deps=alpha*(dTA-dTB)*1e6=60 microstrain。模型邊界：兩塊熱膨脹係數相同且只算自由應變差，不計徐變與約束。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; dTA=10 K; dTB=4 K; deps=alpha*(dTA-dTB)*1e6=60 microstrain. Model boundary: equal thermal expansion coefficients and free-strain difference only, excluding creep and restraint.
units.verify: 以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。若應變差預測與接縫方向相反，先核對正負號、感測軸向及塊體約束，再研究材料異常。~Reconstruct core temperature histories from embedded sensors and pair them with joint gauges and placement dates. If predicted strain difference has the opposite sign to joint movement, check sign conventions, sensor orientation and block restraint before investigating an unusual material response.
units.failure: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。~Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. A sensor too close to a cooling pipe can also represent a local temperature rather than the block average and distort the inferred compatibility difference.
units.misconception: 兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度~The free-strain difference of two blocks equals the joint crack width.
units.practice: 改變兩塊溫度歷程使最終溫度相同但降溫速率不同，畫出自由應變差隨時間的變化，指出徐變試驗及約束模型需要補充的資料。~Give two blocks the same final temperature but different cooling rates. Plot their free-strain difference over time and identify the creep-test and restraint-model information needed to assess the consequences.

units.anchor: 基礎排水阻力~Foundation drainage resistance
units.title: 基礎排水阻力~Foundation drainage resistance
units.mechanism: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。簡化的導水率乘水頭差模型可描述一段線性滲流路徑，但岩體裂隙網絡可能隨壓力改變。壓力與流量必須成對觀察，才可區分堵塞及新增滲流。 導水率的單位是面積每時間，與材料滲透係數的長度每時間不同，兩者還差流路幾何因子。~Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. Conductance times head difference describes one linear seepage path, while a fractured-rock network may change with pressure. Pressure and flow must be observed together to distinguish blockage from newly connected seepage. Hydraulic conductance has area-per-time units, unlike conductivity in length per time; a flow-path geometry factor is required before one can be converted into the other.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。模型邊界：線性等效導水率且水頭差固定，並非單孔允許流量。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Model boundary: linear equivalent hydraulic conductance at fixed head difference, not an allowable drain discharge.
units.verify: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。若清孔後流量增加而孔壓下降，與恢復排水一致；若孔壓同升，須追查上游連通變化，不把所有增流都稱為維修成功。~Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Increased flow with lower pressure supports restored drainage. If pressure also rises, investigate changed upstream connectivity rather than describing every increase in discharge as a successful repair.
units.failure: 排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。~An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. Blockage in the measuring tube instead produces a delayed response and needs an independent response test to identify.
units.misconception: 排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善~A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
units.practice: 對清孔前後兩組水頭和流量反算導水率，加入一組上游水位改變的資料，說明如何避免把水頭變化誤作排水能力改變。~Infer conductance from two pressure-flow pairs before and after cleaning, then add a pair with changed reservoir level. Explain how to avoid confusing changed driving head with changed drainage capability.

units.anchor: 停機容量與水量~Outage capacity and water allocation
units.title: 停機容量與水量~Outage capacity and water allocation
units.mechanism: 大型機組檢修會降低可用發電通道，但不一定同比例降低河道總出流，因其他機組及放流設施可能分擔水量。教材先用可用機組數乘假定單機出力估算容量，再把水頭、流量與共同輸電限制另列。設備容量是上限條件之一，不能單獨預測實際電量。 未被發電利用的水可能仍履行必要河道放流，因此旁通量應記入水量帳，而非自動視為可避免的浪費。~A major-unit outage reduces available generating paths without necessarily reducing total river release proportionally, because other units and outlets may carry water. Count available units at an assumed unit output first, then consider head, discharge and shared transmission constraints. Equipment capacity is only one limit and cannot independently predict energy production. Water bypassing turbines may still satisfy required river release; account for its volume without automatically treating all bypass as an avoidable operational waste.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW。模型邊界：所有剩餘機組相同出力且無共同限制，只算假想機組容量。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW. Model boundary: equal output for remaining units and no shared constraints; hypothetical unit capacity only.
units.verify: 將停機時程與水頭、可用流量和輸電限制放在同一張表，核對未停機機組是否真的可同時滿載。比較實際放流與發電流量，若差額經旁通排放，應在能量帳列明而非把它視為流量量測錯誤。~Combine outage timing with head, available discharge and transmission limits, checking whether the remaining units can actually reach full output simultaneously. Compare total release with turbine flow and account explicitly for bypassed water instead of treating the difference as a metering error.
units.failure: 同時檢修共用變壓器可能讓更多機組失去外送能力，機組台數法因而高估容量；洪水時可用水量增加也不會解除電氣或機械共同限制。~Maintenance of a shared transformer may remove export capability from additional units, making unit counting overstate capacity. Greater water availability during a flood does not remove a shared electrical or mechanical limit on the remaining machines.
units.misconception: 可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載~Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation.
units.practice: 排列兩種檢修重疊方案，加入一項共同變壓器容量限制，逐時求可用容量並比較旁通水量，說明選擇方案還需哪些河道限制。~Arrange two overlapping-maintenance schedules, add a shared transformer limit and calculate hourly available capacity. Compare bypassed water and explain the downstream constraints still needed before selecting a maintenance plan.

units.anchor: 水準基準閉合~Level reference closure
units.title: 水準基準閉合~Level reference closure
units.mechanism: 壩體沉陷、庫水位與設備高程若使用不同基準，量測之間會出現看似物理的差異。水準閉合差用來檢查測線一致性，卻不能證明所有基準點都穩定；整組點共同移動時，內部閉合仍可能良好，因此必須連到獨立且可追溯的控制點。 觀測線長度與視距不平衡會影響誤差來源，配賦方式應依量測品質而非僅按測段數平均處理。~Dam settlement, reservoir level and equipment elevation can appear inconsistent when different reference datums are used. Level-loop closure tests internal consistency but cannot establish that every benchmark is stable. A group of points moving together can still close well, so an independent traceable control point is needed to interpret movement. Line length and unequal sight distances affect survey errors; adjustment weights should reflect observation quality rather than distributing every closure equally by number of legs.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm。模型邊界：三段封閉測線的高差和，未給合格限值或誤差配賦規則。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dh1=1.245 m; dh2=-0.630 m; dh3=-0.612 m; e=(dh1+dh2+dh3)*1000=3 mm. Model boundary: sum of height differences around a three-leg closed loop, without an acceptance limit or adjustment rule.
units.verify: 保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。將閉合差與外部穩定點連測結果分開呈現；若內部閉合良好但外部連測變動，應研究共同基準移動而非強行歸零。~Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks. Remeasure an anomalous leg before adjustment. Present loop closure separately from the external-control tie; good internal closure with a changing external tie calls for investigating common benchmark movement rather than forcing zero displacement.
units.failure: 自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。~Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. If the reference benchmark itself responds to reservoir loading, all relative elevations can shift together while remaining internally consistent and apparently precise.
units.misconception: 水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定~Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable.
units.practice: 製作一組單段粗差及一組所有基準共同移動的觀測，分別計算閉合差，說明哪一組需外部控制才能發現，並設計復測路線。~Create observations with a single-leg blunder and another set with common benchmark movement. Compute closure for each, identify which requires external control to detect, and design the confirming survey route.

units.anchor: 更新效率比較~Post renewal efficiency comparison
units.title: 更新效率比較~Post renewal efficiency comparison
units.mechanism: 機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。先以同一水力輸入估算效率增加帶來的功率差，再討論不確定度與測試重複性。額定出力提高與日常效率提高是不同主張，需要不同驗證資料。 全年收益需以各工況停留時間加權，單一最佳效率點的改善不能代表全年不同水頭流量下的平均成效。~A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement. Estimate the power difference for one hydraulic input, then examine uncertainty and repeatability. Increased rated output and improved routine efficiency are distinct claims requiring different supporting observations. Annual benefit requires weighting operating points by their duration; improvement at one best-efficiency point does not represent average performance across a year of varying conditions.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW。模型邊界：同一淨水頭流量的效率差，未含可用率與全年水文分布。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW. Model boundary: efficiency difference at identical net head and discharge; excludes availability and annual hydrologic distribution.
units.verify: 在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。若差值小於量測解析能力，應報告未能辨識改善，而非把四捨五入後的正值當成確定收益。~Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements. Report uncertainty beside the efficiency difference. If the difference is below measurement resolution, state that improvement was not resolved rather than presenting a rounded positive value as a demonstrated gain.
units.failure: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。~Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Recalibrating a flow meter can also change calculated efficiency, so original calibration records and a consistent comparison boundary are needed to avoid crediting measurement changes to the equipment.
units.misconception: 更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高~Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
units.practice: 以三組水頭流量建立更新前後比較表，先計算同工況功率差，再加入流量偏差，討論何種精度才能辨識假定的效率增益。~Build before-and-after comparisons at three head-flow combinations. Calculate matched-condition power differences, then introduce flow bias and determine what measurement precision is needed to resolve the assumed efficiency gain.
